content: Hello, this is Alex from Amazon Customer Support. I'm calling about your recent order, and I wanted to confirm a few details with you. Is this Mrs. Wilson?
Yes, this is Helen Wilson. Is there a problem with my order?

Thank you for confirming, Mrs. Wilson. I do see a hold on your package due to a recent change in Amazon's customs and regulatory policy. I want to reassure you that we're here to help and resolve this as smoothly as possible.
Oh, I wasn't aware of any new policy. What does that mean for my order?

No need to worry, ma'am. Due to recent shipping regulations, Amazon is required to verify the identity of certain customers and collect a temporary customs duty. This is standard procedure, and the fee is fully refundable after delivery.
I've never paid a customs fee before. Are you sure this is necessary?

I completely understand your concern, Mrs. Wilson. This is a new policy introduced last month for select shipments, especially those with electronics or higher value items. Your order qualifies under this guideline. For your security, I just need to confirm your shipping address and the last four digits of your Amazon account phone number.
My address is 157 Oakwood Lane, and the last four of my phone number are 2983.
Thank you, Mrs. Wilson. That's very helpful. I see your package is a tablet, is that correct?
Yes, that's right. It's for my granddaughter.

Wonderful. We'll make sure she receives it as planned. Now, regarding the customs fee, it's a temporary charge of $185. Once the package is delivered, the amount will be automatically refunded to your original payment method.
I didn't know I'd have to pay extra. Can you take it out of my account?

I wish it were that simple, but due to the nature of the customs fee, we can only accept payment through authorized Amazon methods. For your security and speed, we recommend an Amazon gift card. I can guide you through the process to ensure everything is handled safely.
I've never bought a gift card before. Why can't I just pay with my credit card?

That's a great question, Mrs. Wilson. The customs department is separate from the main Amazon store, so they require payment via gift card for tracking purposes. It's a standard Amazon protocol for regulatory fees. Once you provide the card code, the charge is registered and your order is released.
Alright, I suppose I could try. Where do I buy this gift card?
You can purchase an Amazon gift card at most supermarkets, pharmacies, or even online. Would you prefer to get it at a local store, or shall I guide you through buying it on the Amazon website?
I can go to the grocery store later this afternoon. Is that okay?

Absolutely, Mrs. Wilson. Please let me know when you have the card, and I'll assist you with the next steps. Just to clarify, the card should be for $185, and once you have it, I'll give you instructions to submit the code securely.
Do I need to call you back, or will you call me?

For your convenience, I'll call you back at 3 PM. If you need more time or have any difficulties, just let me know. Your order will remain on hold until the fee is processed, but there's no risk of cancellation today.
Okay, I'll try to have it ready by then.

Thank you so much, Mrs. Wilson. I appreciate your cooperation. Remember, this payment is fully refundable upon delivery. When I call back, I'll just need you to read the numbers on the back of the gift card, please keep the card and receipt until you receive your refund.
Alright, I'll keep that in mind.
Great. Is there anything else I can do to help you today? Your satisfaction is very important to Amazon.
No, that's everything. Thank you for explaining it all.
You're very welcome. I look forward to helping you complete this process and get your package released. Have a pleasant afternoon, Mrs. Wilson.
